title: Add BootReminderReceiver
description: BroadcastReceiver that re-arms every still-pending dose reminder after a reboot, since exact alarms don't survive a device restart. Uses goAsync() plus an IO-dispatcher coroutine to read Room off the main thread, looking up each pending DoseLog's Medication to build the reminder text.
acceptance_criteria: onReceive returns early unless intent.action == Intent.ACTION_BOOT_COMPLETED
onReceive calls goAsync() and launches a CoroutineScope(Dispatchers.IO) coroutine that finishes the PendingResult in a finally block

Inside the coroutine: gets AppDatabase.getDatabase(applicationContext), calls doseLogDao().getPendingReminders(now), and for each pending DoseLog looks up its Medication via medicationDao().getById, skipping if the medication is missing
For each pending DoseLog with its Medication found, calls ExactAlarmScheduler.schedule with the dose log's id, its nextEligibleAtEpochMillis, and a title/text mentioning the medication's name
